_README: MAPPING SIDECAR for tools/tracker/update-tracker.ts. Machine-readable on purpose:
the hook must never infer ownership by guessing at path names.
SCHEMA
version : number    — bump when the shape changes, not when entries change.
rows[]  : { id, title, globs[], note? }
id    — the tracker ROW ID. MUST match the row ids the tracker itself uses
(the gap register's GE-01..GE-12 / GR-01..GR-18 / … vocabulary).
globs — repo-relative, forward-slash. Supports ** (any, incl. /), * (any,
excl. /), ? (one, excl. /). No braces, no extglob.
A path may belong to several rows; it is reported to each. A path in NO row
is reported under UNMAPPED — never silently dropped.
gates[] : { id, gate, evidence[], note? }
evidence — the artefact(s) a gate RUN writes its reading into. Their last
commit is treated as the gate's last recorded measurement. The hook
NEVER executes a gate; it only counts commits since that artefact
changed. If none resolve, the row renders NOT DETERMINED with the
reason — never '0', which would read as 'freshly measured'.
FILLED IN 2026-08-15 by the tracker lane, at HEAD 3afcac71.
· The two provisional ids the file shipped with ('bar-3', 'epsilon-policy') have been
RE-KEYED to real gap-register row ids: 'epsilon-policy' -> GE-01; 'bar-3' -> GR-12,
with the caveat recorded in that gate entry's note (bar 3 is a roadmap-level
PROGRAMME spanning GR-12 and CE-05, not a single register row).
· Every glob below was validated against `git ls-files` at 3afcac71 and matches at
least one tracked path. A glob that matched nothing was DELETED, not left hopeful.
· 50 of the 82 classified rows are mapped (validated: 0 glob misses, 0 evidence
misses, 0 duplicate ids). THE OTHER 32 ARE DELIBERATELY OMITTED,
because no path in the tree could be attributed to them without guessing. They are
named in the tracker (§2, the rows whose Reading cell says NOT DETERMINED), and an
unmapped path is disclosed loudly by the hook's UNMAPPED section. AN UNMAPPED PATH
IS DISCLOSED; A WRONG MAPPING IS INVISIBLE. Omission is the safe direction.
· GR-02 and GR-03 are never mapped: they are not gaps (PARKED / an anti-recount note).
